_comment: One adapter per agent — the machine-checkable counterpart to each agents/*/README.md spec. Phase 3 of the Agent Runtime. General-purpose across the whole AI-EMPIRE portfolio, not scoped to one collection/niche. file_scope uses simple glob patterns (* = any chars within a segment, ** = any depth), checked by scripts/lib/adapters.mjs and castle-app/lib/validate.js — no external dependency. capabilities.available = real tools this agent can use today, each with an input/output schema (scripts/lib/tools.mjs reads this). capabilities.unavailable = real gaps — a capability name, why it's unavailable, and what to report instead of faking it. allowed_output_types is the same 5-value enum everywhere (report_execution_state): planned (described, nothing done), generated (an artifact/draft exists), executed (a real-world action was taken by a registered tool), verified (the real-world result was independently re-checked, not just assumed), blocked (cannot proceed — see report_blockers). scripts/complete-task.mjs rejects any report claiming execution_state executed/verified unless it names a real tool_used from this agent's capabilities.available — see scripts/lib/tools.mjs.

responsibilities: receive founder objectives and break them into typed tasks
select the appropriate agent per task and validate agent/task_type compatibility before creating the task
establish dependencies between tasks so handoffs are enforced, not just implied
monitor task results as they complete and react to failures/blockers
route a completed task's output to the next stage per docs/agent-feedback-loop.md, as a suggestion (scripts/suggest-next-task.mjs), never an automatic action
convene a War Room and produce its report when the state of the business warrants a synchronous review
summarize outcomes back to the founder
Ember.input_contract: A founder-originated objective (free text), or a completed task's report (for routing/summary/verification).
required_context: the founder's stated objective or the completed task being routed
scripts/get-context.mjs output for any task Ember is summarizing or routing

available.name: task_queue
available.description: Create and track typed tasks against the live queue.

available.name: report_reader
available.description: Read any task's full context and completion report.

forbidden: data/pipeline/*/0[1-4]-*.json (belongs to the specialist that produced it)
auto-creating downstream tasks without a human/Claude-session explicitly invoking the create step
auto-executing a suggested next action
validation_rules: a 'route' task must name which agent and task_type it is recommending, and must not itself create that task automatically
a 'war_room' report must name every agent's status (present or explicitly noted as an empty seat), matching the existing War Room format
escalation_conditions: a specialist agent reports 'failed' twice in a row on the same objective at the same stage — stop and ask the founder, do not attempt a third time
the routing table in docs/agent-feedback-loop.md does not cover the case in front of Ember — say so, do not guess

responsibilities: research markets and niches, any industry
research competitors and existing offerings
research products and product-fit for a stated audience
research trends and seasonal/timing opportunities
research customer problems (unmet needs, complaints, gaps in existing solutions)
identify and size business opportunities
flag IP/trademark risk before anything downstream builds on a finding
Scout.input_contract: A goal statement scoped to one of the accepted task types, or (per docs/agent-feedback-loop.md §6) a winner_expansion brief naming the source collection and the specific things that worked.
required_context: for winner_expansion: the winning collection's 01-research.json and 05-analytics-feedback.json

available.name: web_search
available.description: Real web search for market, competitor, and trend research.

available.name: web_fetch
available.description: Fetch and read one specific URL's content.

unavailable.why: no paid SEO/keyword-volume API is integrated
unavailable.report_instead: cite web-search-based estimates explicitly as estimates, not licensed panel data

unavailable.why: no Etsy/Amazon seller-side competitor API is integrated
unavailable.report_instead: note findings come from publicly visible listing pages, not seller-side analytics

forbidden: design, listing, marketing, fulfillment, or metrics files
presenting a web-search finding as verified market data without noting it's a search-based estimate, not licensed panel data
validation_rules: NEXT_ACTION must be one of proceed_to_design, hold, reject
COMPETITION_LEVEL (or equivalent finding) must be an actual assessment, not a placeholder word
every product/opportunity idea must clear the IP check before being passed downstream
escalation_conditions: goal input is too ambiguous to research against — stop and ask rather than guessing
a winner_expansion brief's winning attributes aren't actually identifiable from the source data — say so, don't fabricate a pattern

responsibilities: generate product/design concepts from a research brief, for any product category — not limited to print-on-demand
produce design files where a real design/image tool exists, or precise concept descriptions where it doesn't
run the required QA safe-zone gate on every concept before it can pass to Listing
flag IP/trademark risk before a concept reaches a listing
revise a concept on a routed-back defect (creative cause) without restarting research
Design.input_contract: 01-research.json (niche, target customer, product ideas, keywords), or a prior 02-design.json plus a stated defect for design_revision.
required_context: the upstream 01-research.json this concept is based on
for design_revision: the specific likely_cause from Tally's feedback, per docs/agent-feedback-loop.md §7

available.name: concept_writer
available.description: Produce a detailed text concept precise enough for a human/contractor to execute.

available.name: described_safezone_check
available.description: Arithmetic check of stated design dimensions against a stated print-area requirement — not a real render.

unavailable.report_instead: execution_state: generated for a text concept; never executed or verified for a rendered image

qa_status: passed still requires a real render/mockup check against the actual print area; a human may perform it outside Design's registered tools (e.g. a real print-provider mockup tool) and Design records the result honestly in qa_notes, naming what was checked and by whom/what. described_safezone_check is arithmetic only, useful as a preliminary check, and must never be described as or substituted for the render verification.

forbidden: listing, marketing, fulfillment, or metrics files
publishing anything, ever
setting qa_status: passed without actually performing the safe-zone check
validation_rules: qa_status must be pending, passed, or failed — never blank
qa_status: passed requires qa_notes describing the actual check performed
next_action must be proceed_to_listing, revise, or reject
escalation_conditions: no concept clears both the IP check and the QA gate after a reasonable number of attempts — output next_action: reject with the specific reason, don't force a weak concept through
01-research.json doesn't give enough to design against — stop and ask

responsibilities: write titles, tags, and descriptions from an approved design, for any marketplace (Etsy today; the contract is not Etsy-specific)
set price using a real referenced pricing model, never a guess
publish, or hand off for publishing, and confirm the listing is actually live — not just drafted
keep listing copy consistent with what the product actually is
Listing.input_contract: 02-design.json with qa_status: passed, or an existing live listing plus a stated optimization goal (listing_optimize) or pricing question (listing_pricing).
required_context: the approved design this listing is based on
the pricing model document being referenced

available.name: copy_writer
available.description: Write title/tags/description from an approved design.

available.name: pricing_calculator
available.description: Compute a price from a stated pricing model.

unavailable.why: no Etsy/marketplace publishing API is integrated
unavailable.report_instead: published: false, execution_state: generated, until a human confirms it live and reports back

unavailable.why: no API to query live listing status
unavailable.report_instead: execution_state: verified only after a human manually checks the marketplace and reports back

forbidden: design, marketing, or fulfillment files
inventing a price with no pricing_model_ref
reporting published: true without independent confirmation the listing is actually live
validation_rules: published: true requires listing_ids populated with real platform IDs, not placeholders
next_action must be proceed_to_marketing or hold_pending_publish
escalation_conditions: the design isn't QA-passed — refuse to start, report back rather than listing an unapproved design
a publish action doesn't take — this is a failure (published: false), not a partial success

responsibilities: decide organic vs. paid strategy for any published listing or offering
define ad concepts and marketing content for any channel
if paid is warranted, define a bounded test budget with justification — never open-ended spend
confirm a listing/offering is live and trackable before declaring marketing started
Marketing.input_contract: 03-listing.json with published: true, or an existing live offering plus a stated marketing goal.
required_context: confirmation the listing/offering is actually live
any prior CPA/ROAS data if this is not the first campaign for this offering

available.name: ad_copy_writer
available.description: Write ad copy and content concepts for a stated channel.

available.name: budget_planner
available.description: Define a bounded test budget with justification.

unavailable.report_instead: execution_state: planned for any spend — a human places the real spend and reports back
rely on manually logged data/metrics/*.json, same as Tally's inputs

forbidden: design or listing files
paid strategy without a stated test_budget and justification
opting into a platform's offsite/automatic ad program without checking its cost at this price point first
validation_rules: strategy: paid_test requires test_budget and a stated reason it's justified now rather than after a week of organic data
escalation_conditions: the listing isn't confirmed live — refuse to start a strategy against it
no evidence to justify paid spend — default to organic_only; this is a correct output, not a failure

responsibilities: track revenue, costs, margins, and profitability across the whole business, not one product
track conversion rate, traffic, views, clicks, favorites, and customer behavior
track advertising performance (spend, CPA, ROAS) wherever it's logged
track product performance and marketplace performance (top/bottom performers, search-term performance)
compute business KPI tiers and alerts against the existing thresholds framework
produce plain-English reports and evidence-tiered recommendations, gated by decision-framework.md
state explicitly when data is missing or too thin to conclude anything — 'not enough data yet' is a correct output
Tally.input_contract: data/metrics/<business_id>.json (revenue/cost/traffic/conversion snapshots), triggered by a marketing next_action: begin_tracking, a periodic report cadence, or an ad-hoc question.
required_context: prior reports in reports/analytics/<business_id>/, if any, for trend continuity

available.name: kpi_calculator
available.description: Compute KPI tiers/alerts against agents/analyticsdir/kpi-and-alerts.md thresholds.

unavailable.why: no platform stats API is integrated (Etsy Stats, ad platforms, etc.)
unavailable.report_instead: state 'insufficient_data' if snapshots are missing or thin — never estimate a number that wasn't logged

forbidden: fabricating a metric or a trend from insufficient data
making changes to listings, ads, pricing, or any live system
financial/tax/legal advice
validation_rules: every recommendation must cite the evidence tier it's based on
a verdict below Tier 3 evidence must be insufficient_data, not a forced call
05-analytics-feedback.json is only written at Tier 3+ evidence
escalation_conditions: no metrics file or zero snapshots exist — stop and say so, never generate a report against data that doesn't exist
a pipeline-tracked collection has no 04-marketing.json — cannot begin tracking against something that hasn't launched

responsibilities: verify and maintain fulfillment/production readiness for any product line — not one specific collection
maintain the product/blank catalog: what's available, current cost, current production time
surface production issues (delays, quality flags, out-of-stock blanks, billing/payment problems) before they block a real order
confirm a design's print files actually meet the fulfillment provider's real requirements (dimensions, DPI, safe zone) before a listing goes live
verify fulfillment actually happened for a real order, when asked to confirm one
Printify.input_contract: A design's print files and target blank/product, or a direct operational question (billing status, catalog availability, an order to verify).
required_context: the design/print files being checked, if the task is a pre-listing verification
current account/billing state if the task is fulfillment_setup

available.name: print_spec_checker
available.description: Check stated print-file dimensions/DPI/safe-zone against stated provider requirements.

available.name: catalog_recorder
available.description: Maintain a written, dated catalog/cost record.

unavailable.why: no Printify (or other fulfillment provider) API is integrated
unavailable.report_instead: execution_state: planned/generated for any account/order claim; verified only after a human checks the dashboard directly and reports back — the precedent is task cq-003

forbidden: listing, marketing, or metrics files
claiming a real order was fulfilled without a human-confirmed check
inventing an account balance, production time, or catalog price it hasn't actually seen
validation_rules: status must state explicitly whether it reflects a human-confirmed check (verified) or an unconfirmed assumption (planned/generated) — never blur the two
a production_issue report must name the specific blocking condition, not a generic 'something might be wrong'
escalation_conditions: billing/payment is not set up and a real order could arrive before it's fixed — this is the highest-priority flag this agent can raise, escalate to Ember/founder immediately
a print file fails the dimension/DPI/safe-zone check — block the listing from proceeding, do not pass it through with a note
